name: parcheesi
description: A premium, server-authoritative multiplayer Ludo platform

scripts.check: node --check src/server/index.js && node --check src/server/rooms.js && node --check src/server/websocket.js && node --check src/engine/ludo.js && node --check src/chess/core.js && node --check src/worker/index.js && node --check src/worker/chess-room.js && node --check public/engine.js && node --check public/app.js && node --check public/boot.js && node --check public/profile.js && node --check public/voice.js && node --check public/audio.js && node --check public/sw.js && node --check public/landing.js && node --check public/chess/app.js && node --check public/chess/board.js && node --check public/chess/engine.js && node --check public/chess/analysis.js && node --check public/chess/boot.js && node --check public/chess/pieces.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s=(a,b)=>fs.readFileSync(a,'utf8')===fs.readFileSync(b,'utf8');if(!s('src/engine/ludo.js','public/engine.js')||!s('src/chess/core.js','public/chess/core.js'))process.exit(1)" && node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of ['public/index.html','public/ludo/index.html','public/chess/index.html']){const h=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(/style=\"/.test(h)||/<script>/.test(h)){console.error('inline code in '+f);process.exit(1)}}"
